bds.h: Silicon Valley leaders call for reinstatement of Nvidia CEO with 'Stand With Jensen' petition
bds.lede: A petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO is drawing support from prominent Silicon Valley personalities, four days after his resignation stemming from revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.
rows: As tech industry pushes for return, US president says he thinks Huang ‘learned a big lesson’

A petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO is drawing support from prominent Silicon Valley personalities, four days after his resignation stemming from revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.
U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday he would not mind seeing Jensen Huang reinstated as the chief executive officer of Nvidia and many people would like to see him return.
A number of tech figures want the board of the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
